title: Five-release matched full-field versus moving-window validation

panels.content: Five releases and their arithmetic means
panels.mapping: Five paired simulations with a stationary target. Rows give translations, RMS centre position, heading and velocity differences, and measured full-field/moving-window wall time per solver step. The Mean row is the arithmetic mean across the five releases. Maximum errors support the accompanying validation text.
